stage.name: Long Spring Wastes
stage.description:
After the 'Watchtower 33' incident, some 'Redmark' mercenaries avoided Rhodes Island's pursuit while controlling the remnant Originiutant mutants. If these organisms are allowed to escape to other areas, the outcome would be disastrous. Please carry out a thorough extermination.
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally
<Sandstorm> Allied units caught inside the sandstorm will have reduced ATK, continuously take damage over time, and have extended redeployment time; Enemy units will instead be slowed

originiutant_puppet.name: Originiutant Puppet
originiutant_puppet.flavourText: A corpse being controlled by a parasitic Originiutant Excrescence.

hound_pro.name: Hound Pro
hound_pro.flavourText: A creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad that is more dangerous than a normal Hound. Monitoring equipment is strapped to its body. Due to their speed and evasiveness, they can easily slip through enemy defenses and cause heavy damage.

mutant_rock_spider_enemy_1132_sarchn_2.name: Mutant Rock Spider α
mutant_rock_spider_enemy_1132_sarchn_2.flavourText: A rock spider infected and severely mutated by an Originiutant. Due to their similar appearances, rock spiders are often mistakenly believed to be a close relative of Infused Originium Slugs. However, the latest research shows that they are two completely different species.

sarkaz_blademaster.name: Sarkaz Blademaster
sarkaz_blademaster.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary, more skilled than an ordinary Sarkaz Swordsman. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

mutant_rock_spider_enemy_1132_sarchn.name: Mutant Rock Spider
mutant_rock_spider_enemy_1132_sarchn.flavourText: A rock spider infected by an Originiutant. Due to their similar appearances, rock spiders are often mistakenly believed to be a close relative of Infused Originium Slugs. However, the latest research shows that they are two completely different species.

mutant_sand_beast_enemy_1131_sbeast.name: Mutant Sand Beast
mutant_sand_beast_enemy_1131_sbeast.flavourText: A sand beast infected by an Originiutant. Sand beasts are a species of small-sized omnivores that primarily inhabit deserts and hamadas. They are nocturnal in nature and are often tamed by the local Sargonians to be used as hunting beasts.

sarkaz_greatswordsman.name: Sarkaz Greatswordsman
sarkaz_greatswordsman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

sarkaz_crossbowman.name: Sarkaz Crossbowman
sarkaz_crossbowman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

mutant_giant_rock_spider_enemy_1133_harc.name: Mutant Giant Rock Spider α
mutant_giant_rock_spider_enemy_1133_harc.flavourText: A giant rock spider infected and severely mutated by an Originiutant. Giant rock spiders are a subspecies of rock spider found only in Sargon. They possess a large circular abdomen used to store energy.

redmark_elite_infiltrator.name: 'Redmark' Elite Infiltrator
redmark_elite_infiltrator.flavourText: An elite mercenary infiltrator who carries high-tech projection equipment, specializing in infiltrating enemy forces within harsh environments. 'Redmark Contracts' are tailor-made for elite and powerful mercenaries with a distinct lack of morals. The initiators of such contracts are ruthless and definitely up to no good.
abilities: Creates a <Holographic Mirage MK2> upon taking damage for the first time
While the <Holographic Mirage MK2> exists, cannot be blocked and becomes less likely to be attacked
Gains Physical and Arts Dodge while within the <Sandstorm>

sarkaz_crossbowman_leader.name: Sarkaz Crossbowman Leader
sarkaz_crossbowman_leader.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Sniper. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

mutant_giant_rock_spider_enemy_1133_harc.name: Mutant Giant Rock Spider
mutant_giant_rock_spider_enemy_1133_harc.flavourText: A giant rock spider infected by an Originiutant. Giant rock spiders are a subspecies of rock spider found only in Sargon. They possess a large circular abdomen used to store energy.

redmark_infiltrator.name: 'Redmark' Infiltrator
redmark_infiltrator.flavourText: A special mercenary infiltrator who carries high-tech projection equipment, specializing in infiltrating enemy forces within harsh environments. 'Redmark Contracts' are tailor-made for elite and powerful mercenaries with a distinct lack of morals. The initiators of such contracts are ruthless and definitely up to no good.
abilities: Creates a <Holographic Mirage> upon taking damage for the first time
While the <Holographic Mirage> exists, cannot be blocked and becomes less likely to be attacked
Gains Physical and Arts Dodge while within the <Sandstorm>

redmark_elite_eradicator.name: 'Redmark' Elite Eradicator
redmark_elite_eradicator.flavourText: An elite mercenary sniper who excels at ambushing targets exposed in harsh environments. 'Redmark Contracts' are tailor-made for elite and powerful mercenaries with a distinct lack of morals. The initiators of such contracts are ruthless and definitely up to no good.
abilities: Only performs ranged attacks against allied units caught inside the <Sandstorm>
